services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: Down the Bayou offers cobia fishing charters that will stock your freezer with the versatile and delicious fillets of the cobia. Also known as lemon fish or ling, cobia are very unique fish. They migrate the entire gulf yearly. They will start showing up in late spring and stay around until late fall. Cobia fishing in Louisiana usually involves catching them off oil rigs or floating debris in the open ocean. Some days they can be picky eaters and other days it doesn’t matter what you throw at them. They operate a fleet of high-performance boats designed for comfort and effective fishing. Trips cater to families, serious anglers, and those seeking trophy fish experiences.
